name: Add Superpower
description: Adds the given superpower to the entity.

fields.description: The ID of the superpower to add.

name: Directional Leap
description: Like palladium:leap, but sets the velocity to your look direction scaled by the velocity modifier instead of adding to it, so the leap always goes where you aim.

fields.description: The multiplier applied to the entity's look direction when this action runs.

name: Conditional Action
description: Runs an action based on the outcome of a condition

fields.description: The condition(s) that define the action that will run.
The action(s) that are being run when the condition is true
The action(s) that are being run when the condition is false

name: Set On Fire
description: Sets the entity on fire for the specified amount of time in ticks.

fields.description: How long the entity will burn.

name: Dash
description: Pushes the entity horizontally in the direction it is facing, scaled by a velocity modifier. Unlike Leap it ignores whether the entity looks up or down, so the push stays level, and it adds to the entity's current movement. Negative values push backwards.

fields.description: How strongly the entity is pushed, in blocks per tick. Can be a Value, for example one that reads a data attachment.

name: Modify Number Data Attachment
description: Applies an arithmetic operation to a numeric data attachment on the entity.

fields.description: The ID of the data attachment to modify.
The arithmetic operation to apply.
The operand value.

name: Set Data Attachment
description: Sets the value of a data attachment on the entity.

fields.description: The ID of the data attachment to set.
The value to set the data attachment to.

name: Run Command
description: Runs a Minecraft command

fields.description: The command(s) that are being run.

name: Add Random Superpower
description: Adds a random superpower from the given list to the entity.

fields.description: IDs or tags of powers to randomly pick from.

name: Extinguish
description: Clears fire from the entity.

fields.description: If true, clears the fire without additional effects like sounds.

name: Change Size
description: Animates the entity's size to the target value using the given size change type's duration and easing. Inside an ability the size belongs to that ability, so running the action again with the same type replaces its earlier value. Outside of abilities all change_size actions share one size per type.

fields.description: The size change type defining the transition duration, easing, and min/max bounds.
The target size to transition to.

name: Jump
description: Launches the entity straight up like a jump, keeping its sideways movement. A normal jump is about 0.42 and gets roughly 1.25 blocks, 0.8 gets roughly 4.5.

fields.description: The upward speed, in blocks per tick.
Whether the speed is added to the entity's current vertical speed instead of replacing it.

name: Leap
description: Launches the entity along its current look direction, scaled by a velocity modifier.

fields.description: The multiplier applied to the entity's look direction vector when this action runs.

name: Set Mode
description: Forces a mode switch ability into a specific mode, ignoring that mode's conditions.

fields.description: The mode switch ability to change.
The key of the mode the ability is set to.

name: Ride
description: Mounts the entity you look at, once. "ride_target" makes you ride it, "target_rides_player" puts it on top of you instead (toggled off if triggered again).

fields.description: Which way to mount: "ride_target" (user rides target) or "target_rides_player" (target rides user).
How far away, along the user's line of sight, an entity can be to be targeted.

name: Heal
description: Heals the entity.

fields.description: The amount of health to heal.

name: Set Superpower
description: Removes all superpowers from the entity and sets it to just the given one.

fields.description: The ID of the superpower to set.

name: Set Fall Distance
description: Sets the fall distance of the entity.

fields.description: The value the fall distance is set to.

name: Set Random Superpower
description: Removes all superpowers from the entity and sets it to a random one from the given list.

fields.description: IDs or tags of powers to randomly pick from.

name: Remove Superpower
description: Removes the given superpowers from the entity.

fields.description: IDs or tags of superpowers to remove.

name: As Target
description: Runs actions on the target entity instead of the entity itself. The target is the entity an ability affected. It is known in the final attack actions of combo attacks, the entity hit actions of beams and blasts, the actions of area actions, the actions of action on hit and the entity hit actions of custom projectiles. Only combo attacks run their actions on the attacker, the others already run them on the affected entity. Without a target, nothing happens. Everything else in the context, like the ability or power, stays the same.

fields.description: The action(s) that are run on the target.

name: Set Size
description: Instantly sets the entity's size, clearing all active size modifiers. The size change type is used for min/max clamping.

fields.description: The size change type whose min/max bounds are used to clamp the size.
The target size to set.

name: Play Sound
description: Plays a sound at the entity's position.

fields.description: The ID of the sound event to play.
The volume of the sound. Defaults to 1.
The pitch of the sound. Defaults to 1.
